new.title: fix(record): release observers, buffers and listeners the recorder no longer needs (supersedes #1968)
new.author: eoghanmurray
new.reason: Recorder memory/iframe cleanup; supersedes #1968 and overlaps #1970. Green observed checks are not human approval. Ask Eoghan to coordinate sequencing and release inclusion.

new.title: fix: don't re-observe same-origin iframes on full snapshot
new.author: Debasishhh
new.reason: Same-origin iframe duplicate observers. Compare the focused fix with #1971 to avoid adopting overlapping implementations.

new.title: fix(record): re-send cross-origin iframe snapshots after the parent's full snapshot
new.author: JustYannicc
new.reason: Cross-origin iframe resnapshot and listener cleanup. Compare with #1971 and older #1465 before choosing a combined path.

new.title: fix(snapshot): skip inlining blocked images
new.author: adityareddy-dev
new.reason: Blocked-image serialization: check both loaded and pending images, and ensure callbacks cannot repopulate blocked placeholders. Actions require maintainer attention before CI can be assessed.

new.title: fix(rrweb-snapshot): do not record the document of a blocked iframe
new.author: arivyiii
new.reason: Blocked iframe documents must not be serialized or observed. Review capture-time blocking and regression coverage; run gated Actions.

new.title: fix: release stopped recorder mutation buffers and snapshots
new.author: Juice10
new.reason: Recorder memory cleanup overlaps #1971 and related lifecycle work. Draft with merge conflict; align scope before further review.

new.title: fix(network): retain status and timing without Resource Timing
new.author: sean0407
new.reason: Network status/timing fallback. Address automated P2 feedback about the XHR status snapshot race, then obtain human review and run Actions.

new.title: Version Packages
new.author: github-actions[bot]
new.reason: Generated Version Packages PR. Not a routine bug fix: coordinate package contents and publishing timing with release owner Eoghan.

new.title: fix(browser-client): recover uploads after WebSocket disconnects
new.author: Juice10
new.reason: Upload recovery and bounded retry behavior. Observed checks are green; needs human review of delivery ordering and failure handling.

new.title: fix(rrweb-snapshot): don't rewrite blob: urls in css url()
new.author: sarmah-rup
new.reason: Small blob: URL preservation change. Check CSS URL cases and run gated Actions; no submitted review.

new.title: feat(rrweb-player): add public external timeline-marker API
new.author: Juice10
new.reason: Public external timeline-marker API. Resolve current merge conflicts, Snyk failure, and maintainer question about relation to merged #1928.

new.title: feat(rrvideo): add controlled MP4 and compositor capture
new.author: Juice10
new.reason: Controlled MP4/compositor capture. Larger feature and still a draft; validate platform support and capture comparisons before promoting.

new.title: fix(rrweb): keep the original getter in hookSetter (Firefox content scripts)
new.author: olvang
new.reason: Firefox content-script getter preservation. Validate accessor semantics and browser regressions; run gated Actions.

new.title: fix(rrweb-snapshot): capture and rebuild adoptedStyleSheets
new.author: Ramshankar-Chellappa
new.reason: Standalone snapshot adoptedStyleSheets support changes serialized data. Review round-trip compatibility and interaction with the full recorder’s incremental path.

new.title: fix(rrweb-snapshot): keep every attribute on an inlined img that has a srcset
new.author: SaintPepsi
new.reason: Focused srcset attribute fix, but the head Tests workflow failed. Diagnose or rerun with evidence before treating as ready.

new.title: fix(web-extension): prevent cross-origin recording leaks
new.author: Juice10
new.reason: Extension cross-origin recording isolation. Important privacy motivation, but remains a draft. Validate intended frame behavior before promoting.

new.title: fix: recover native Proxy using shared iframe lookup
new.author: Juice10
new.reason: Native Proxy recovery; carries forward closed #1812. Review iframe lifecycle and automated feedback. PostHog requested this, but that is not evidence it has shipped.

new.title: Collapse multiple text/attribute mutations when throttled (or frozen) & add per-element throttling config
new.author: eoghanmurray
new.reason: Mutation deduplication/throttling; carries forward closed #1694. Green checks do not resolve the current merge conflict. PostHog requested the work; adoption is not verified.

new.title: fix(rrweb): record iframe canvas drawImage mutations
new.author: Juice10
new.reason: Same-origin iframe canvas observation. Draft with merge conflicts; review cross-realm serialization and align with iframe cleanup work.
